_comment: Azure CycleCloud / dual-filesystem reference config. Only use this pattern if your OOD host and compute nodes see DIFFERENT shared filesystems (e.g. OOD's /shared is NFS, compute nodes have their own local /shared that mounts OOD's via NFS at /sched-shared). See docs/CYCLECLOUD.md for full details.
_comment_proxy: sbatch/squeue/scancel are forwarded over SSH to a separate CycleCloud-managed Slurm scheduler VM. Point these at your local proxy scripts installed under /etc/ood/config/clusters.d/<id>/bin_overrides/.
_comment_cc: SSH target for the scheduler VM. The backend runs SSH commands there to prep project directories before submitting jobs.
_comment_nfs: Compute nodes mount OOD's /shared here (at /sched-shared) so RELION jobs can access user data. Set to the OOD host's private hostname or IP.
